__meta__.description: Server-enforced RBAC user management for NexusTalent OS

users.__doc__: Stores user identity, server-enforced roles, and base profile data.
users.__security__: Users can read own doc; super_admin reads all. Self-registration allowed only for 'student' | 'employer' | 'institution'. 'super_admin' role is assigned exclusively via admin provisioning or designated authorization whitelist.
